description: Finds every visual effect the game calls for -- impacts, trails, auras, environment effects -- and lists what exists against what is missing. Produces a list, never the effects.
when_to_use: the request is 'what effects do we still need'
abilities or impacts have no effect attached
a vfx generation run needs a list to work from
avoid_when: the list already exists and the request is to produce the effects
the effect needs engine-side scripting rather than an asset
inputs: the art bible when there is one
